Describe institutions that support small business.

body.en: *Small* units face shortage of finance and credit, difficulty in getting raw materials of good quality at fair prices, lack of managerial skills, difficulty in getting and keeping skilled labour, weak marketing, poor quality standards, low capacity utilisation, outdated technology, sickness of units, and growing competition from large firms and global players.

title.en: On the board: Problems and government help

narration.en: Small units face many problems, mostly from their small size.

say.en: Small units face many problems, mostly from their small size.
The government set up many institutions to help. Let us place them on a timeline.
NSIC supplies machines on hire-purchase; DICs are a single window in each district; NABARD supports rural industry; SIDBI is the main MSME financier.
SFURTI revives traditional industries through clusters, and ASPIRE promotes innovation and rural entrepreneurship.

explanation.en: Government bodies tackle the problems of small units: finance (SIDBI, NABARD), machinery and marketing (NSIC), local support (DICs) and clusters and innovation (SFURTI, ASPIRE).

body.en: NSIC (National Small Industries Corporation, 1955) promotes small industries, supplies machinery on hire-purchase and helps with marketing. NABARD (1982) promotes rural development, including small, cottage and village industries, and set up Rural *Small Business* Development Centres (RSBDCs). SIDBI (1990) is the principal financial institution for promoting, financing and developing MSMEs. District Industries Centres (DICs, 1978) act as a single-window agency at district level. Schemes such as SFURTI (2005) regenerate traditional industries through clusters, and ASPIRE (2015) promotes innovation and rural entrepreneurship.
body.kn: ಎನ್‌ಎಸ್‌ಐಸಿ, ನಬಾರ್ಡ್, ಸಿಡ್ಬಿ ಮತ್ತು ಜಿಲ್ಲಾ ಕೈಗಾರಿಕಾ ಕೇಂದ್ರಗಳು ಹಣಕಾಸು, ಯಂತ್ರೋಪಕರಣ, ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನದ ಮೂಲಕ ಸಣ್ಣ ಉದ್ಯಮಗಳಿಗೆ ನೆರವು ನೀಡುತ್ತವೆ.

say.en: Let us work through this together. A small unit in Ballari has these needs: a a loan to modernise, b a lathe machine on instalments, c one office in the district to get all clearances, d help for a cluster of traditional weavers. Which agency or scheme fits each?
a Finance for an MSME: SIDBI.
b Machinery on hire-purchase: NSIC.
c District-level single window: District Industries Centre DIC.
d Regenerating traditional industry clusters: SFURTI.
So the answer is a SIDBI, b NSIC, c DIC, d SFURTI.
